critical_mismatches: Hallucination: candidate adds "der russische rosendal" — the reference names the location as Rosendahl (no "russische").
Place-name errors: candidate repeatedly renders Gronau as "kronau"/"grunau" (incorrect and potentially misleading).

Omission: candidate omits key details about cutting being outsourced to Backers Heimes and the description of small blockware production (Mediterraneo, paprika/chili) and the rationale for producing Gouda blocks during the milk surplus (important semantic content).
Hallucination: candidate inserts technical machinery details (machine for beakers with "75er Durchmesser", gram sizes, "amman 1317") that do not appear in the reference.
Distortion of processing step: candidate renders "eingestellt und erhitzt" as garbled "eingestellt unterhetzt" which changes/obscures the intended meaning of the heat-treatment step.
rationale: The candidate preserves the high-level structure (20,000 t/yr milk products, milk sent to the Rosendahl cheesemaking site, ~1,100 t/yr cheese, external warehouse near Epe ~6 km) but omits several meaning-bearing segments (notably the slicing/backers supplier and blockware/Gouda production explanation) and introduces multiple hallucinations (an incorrect qualifier for Rosendahl, fabricated machine specs) and place-name errors (Gronau misspelled/mistranscribed). Numbers that appear in the reference are mostly retained, but the added and distorted content and significant omissions materially reduce fidelity.
